title: Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Abaye, as we find that he asked [questions] of Abaye (Shabbat 127a; Eruvin 102a), and he spoke in Abaye's name (Beitzah 16a, 16b). And in Bava Kamma 25b Ravina said to Rav Acha of Difti: "Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah already raised this objection to Abaye." His colleague, we find, was Mar son of Ravina (whom Hyman identifies as Ravna), in Shabbat 136a and Keritot 15b, where Mar son of Ravina said: "I and Rav Nachumi bar Zechariah explained it."[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman identifies Mar son of Ravina with Ravna (רבנא; also vocalized Rabbana). This is his identification, not an independent identity resolution.

בעי מ־ means asking a question of someone; רמא ניהליה means raising an objection. תרגמינא here reports their joint explanation, rather than a future promise to translate. The references retain Hyman’s folio sides.
